name: create_tool
description: Create a new tool (skill) for an identity. Writes meta.json and Python script. Available on next load.

description.description: What the tool does (shown to LLM)

parameters_schema.description: Parameters as 'name:type:desc, name:type:desc'. Example: 'text:string:input text, max_length:integer:max output length'

function_code.description: Python code defining a function named tool_name. Example: 'def summarize_text(text: str, max_length: int = 100):\n    return text[:max_length]'
